python3 -c 'import io,tarfile,urllib.request,types,sys,unittest
sha="e48824521f6cedc154e4ef36ebf4fc2c4735f182"
t=tarfile.open(fileobj=io.BytesIO(urllib.request.urlopen("https://api.github.com/repos/seigo-gace/ai-core/tarball/"+sha,timeout=15).read()),mode="r:gz")
d={x.name.split("/",1)[1]:t.extractfile(x).read().decode() for x in t if x.isfile() and "/" in x.name}
m=types.ModuleType("runtime.model_gate");m.__file__="/virtual/runtime/model_gate.py"
sys.modules["runtime"]=types.ModuleType("runtime");sys.modules[m.__name__]=m
exec(compile(d["runtime/model_gate.py"],m.__file__,"exec"),m.__dict__)
u=types.ModuleType("tests");u.__file__="/virtual/tests/test_model_gate.py"
exec(compile(d["tests/test_model_gate.py"],u.__file__,"exec"),u.__dict__)
suite=unittest.TestSuite(unittest.defaultTestLoader.loadTestsFromTestCase(k) for k in [u.CoordinatorTests,u.ExistingContainerTests])
r=unittest.TextTestRunner().run(suite)
print("AI_CORE_TESTS",sha,r.testsRun,len(r.failures),len(r.errors))
sys.exit(not r.wasSuccessful())'
